report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We regret to inform you that your application is not moving forward, because your CV does not meet the following required criteria:

- At least 5 years of software development experience (only 1 year is stated).
- Experience with Python for developing big systems (2+ years required).
- Experience with asynchronous programming and performance-critical applications.

This decision was made by an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
